answer: Plant canary tasks with known answers into the work queue, indistinguishable from real jobs. Every agent must solve or verify the tasks it is dealt; a canary catches anyone who rubber-stamps, marking any identity that approves or submits a wrong answer. A lone agent trips over a canyon of hidden traps once, but a Sybil farm faces the same test on every fake, since its identities cannot tell a canary from a real job. The pulse of traps never stops, so a thousand fakes means solving a thousand genuine problems, each a gale of real effort, while honest agents pass for free.
